what: step-7a is specified to swallow rebase-checkpoint-probe's nonzero exit even though the Rebase Checkpoint Macro branches on that exit code
scenario_or_breakage: A 7a.r conflict emits REBASE_OUTCOME=conflict and exits 1 in the child, but step-7a exits 0; the macro's Exit 1 branch never runs and the implementation can proceed into version bump during an unresolved rebase
suggested_fix: Either let step-7a exit with the probe rc for rc 1/3/other and document those exit codes, or rewrite the macro and tests to route only on step-7a-emitted REBASE_OUTCOME

what: The plan assumes probe emit lines pass through inherited FD 3, but the probe never calls larch_quiet_init and emit_kv prints to stdout when LARCH_QUIET_PID differs from the child PID
scenario_or_breakage: When invoked normally from a quiet step-7a, child stdout is step-7a's quiet log, so REBASE_OUTCOME/CONFLICT_FILES/PHANTOM_* are not reachable by the SKILL macro
suggested_fix: Run the probe with stdout redirected to step-7a's contract FD, or capture stdout and re-emit each KV with step-7a's emit/emit_kv; add a quiet-mode harness assertion

what: The sanitizer rejection contract is misidentified
scenario_or_breakage: Actual generator sanitizer rejection emits STATUS=skipped with SKIP_REASON tokens like pipe-in-node-label or br-in-participant-alias; proposed checks/tests using STATUS=failed SKIP_REASON=sanitizer-rejected can miss real rejects and still upsert larch:diagrams
suggested_fix: Define STATUS=skipped from generate-code-flow-diagram.sh as sanitizer rejection, or match the concrete REASON_TOKEN set; update test-step-7a to stub STATUS=skipped with a real token

what: DIAGRAM_PATH is claimed to match the generator output convention, but the child emits DIAGRAM_FILE
scenario_or_breakage: A test or implementation that parses DIAGRAM_PATH from child output will see an empty value even when generation succeeded
suggested_fix: State that step-7a's public DIAGRAM_PATH is wrapper-owned and maps from child DIAGRAM_FILE or the fixed generated path; keep child stubs emitting DIAGRAM_FILE

what: LOG_FLUSH_STATUS cannot degrade on transcript capture failure as written
scenario_or_breakage: render-failed/write-failed/source-file-missing are emitted as SESSION_TRANSCRIPT_STATUS and exit 0; the plan says capture but do not act on the status line, so final LOG_FLUSH_STATUS can be ok despite a missing transcript
suggested_fix: Capture SESSION_TRANSCRIPT_STATUS and classify non-captured statuses as degraded, or remove capture-session-transcript from LOG_FLUSH_STATUS degraded semantics and tests

what: larch-log commit failure is claimed to be logged/degraded but the proposed invocation uses bare || true
scenario_or_breakage: Default-branch guard, post-merge sentinel, or git commit failure exits nonzero, then step-7a swallows it and may report LOG_FLUSH_STATUS=ok
suggested_fix: Wrap commit with set +e, redirect stdout and stderr to a temp log, check rc, call append-tool-failure.sh with that file, and set LOG_FLUSH_STATUS=degraded

what: larch-log write failures are promised as Tool Failures but the listed write calls are all bare best-effort
scenario_or_breakage: A missing report file, unknown batch, redaction failure, or payload validation error only writes LOG_WRITTEN=false/ERROR to stdout and is swallowed by || true, so execution-issues.md lacks the promised Tool Failures entry
suggested_fix: Either align the plan with current SKILL.md by saying write failures are intentionally quiet best-effort, or capture each write's stdout/stderr and route failures through append-tool-failure.sh without flipping LOG_FLUSH_STATUS

what: The plan says capture-session-transcript stdout remains visible, but under a quiet step-7a its emit_kv status goes to step-7a's quiet log unless redirected or captured
scenario_or_breakage: The observable SESSION_TRANSCRIPT_STATUS line present in current SKILL.md disappears after consolidation even on the green path
suggested_fix: If visibility is part of the preserved contract, route capture-session-transcript stdout to step-7a FD3 or capture and re-emit SESSION_TRANSCRIPT_STATUS; otherwise document the intentional removal
